Class Game

java.lang.Object
mesos.game.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements Serializable
Top-level orchestrator: owns the Board, the players, the round counter and the GamePhase state machine. Fires PropertyChangeEvents for PHASE / ERA / ROUND so the (Virtual) View can mirror state remotely.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(PlayerCount playerCount, List<Player> players)
      Creates a new game for the given players. The phase is GamePhase.SETUP; call startGame() to proceed.
      Parameters:
      playerCount - the number of players
      players - the list of players (order will be randomised during setup)

  • Method Details

    • setListener

      public void setListener(PropertyChangeListener listener)
      Registers the listener that receives a PropertyChangeEvent after every state mutation. Also propagates the listener to all players.
      Parameters:
      listener - the listener to register

    • setup

      public void setup()
      Builds decks, configures the board, randomises the initial turn order, reveals the initial rows, and distributes initial food. Transitions the phase to GamePhase.PLACEMENT.

    • assignInitialFood

      public void assignInitialFood()
      Distributes initial food to players based on their position in the turn order. The first player receives 2 food, positions 2–3 receive 3, and later positions receive 4.

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Starts the game. Calls setup() if the phase is still GamePhase.SETUP; idempotent if setup has already run.

    • placeTotem

      public boolean placeTotem(Player player, OfferTile tile)
      Moves the player's totem from the Turn Order Tile to the chosen Offer Tile and records the selection. Returns true on success; false if the tile is unknown, occupied, or null. Single Model entry-point so the listener mechanism (and any future per-totem events) can hang off this method.
      Parameters:
      player - the player placing their totem
      tile - the offer tile to place on
      Returns:
      true if placement succeeded

    • actionPhase

      public void actionPhase()
      Transitions to GamePhase.ACTION_RESOLUTION and records each player's selected tile in resolution order (A → G).

    • setExtraPickPending

      public void setExtraPickPending(Player player)
      Signals that the given player is waiting for their B020 extra top-row pick.

      public String getExtraPickPendingId()

    • markPlayerDone

      public void markPlayerDone(Player player)
      Marks the given player as having finished their action for this round. When all players are done, automatically triggers endOfRound().
      Parameters:
      player - the player who completed their action

    • endOfRound

      public void endOfRound()
      Resolves the end of a round: notifies buildings, then either resolves the final round (when the deck is exhausted or round 10 is complete) or a normal round.

    • handleRefillResult

      public void handleRefillResult(RowRefillResult result)
      Applies the result of a row refill: handles era transitions and sets the deck-exhausted flag if applicable.
      Parameters:

    • triggerEndGame

      public void triggerEndGame()
